description: We are the Royal Bongalese Space Agency, name copyrighted. We have only recently formed, but rest assured, we have a long way to go. We look to the heavens and the great expanse above for such creation holds our gaze. The Captain and his crew of high-school students constitute this agency.
summary: We have developed a web app called "Observa Terram". Essentially, it allows anyone to compare the SAR images for a restricted geographical area and observe the changes in land structure. The app allows one to compare the SAR images of the place over a few dates: from June to October of this year. We plan to expand the app to hold and extract data of an area of interest across different imagery, all over the world, and in different previous dates, with accurate scientific information. Then, not only will the layman be able to know the changing world around him, but so also will the scientist benefit from it. Finally, we have presented our hypothesis in the app itself, keeping in mind that these are only our observations and may be proven false.
details: We have made the UI of Observa Terram simple enough for anyone to easily operate it without needing a tutorial. This app concerns itself with a piece of land in Hyderabad that has undergone considerable change in the past year and more. We, being non-coders entirely, have used Gemini AI to write the Python code, and for that purpose in the project only. We ourselves have imagined the concept and UI of the app and have directed the AI accordingly. Using GitHub to publish the code and Streamlit to make the app, we have brought our imagination to life. We have focused on this particular plot of land as a sample geographical place for the moment being, keeping in mind that future extensions in the app can expand it to analyse any geographical area in the world. We have considered the fact that the drastic changes in it in the past year would easily be distinguishable in the SAR images of the same.
